fusions.name: Combing Tines
fusions.desc: Rakes fine filaments across the target, dealing 7 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and making it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Thousand Tendrils
fusions.desc: Whips filaments out around you, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Each target is left [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Combed Clear
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Fine Fringe
fusions.desc: Conjures a fringe of reef filaments: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your dodge chance rises by 3%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
